headline.text: L1 Sollich 4 lost *3 hours* on a forming issue that needed tunnel scrap — back up by 23:12.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 Sollich 4 had texture and temperature swings through first shift, then a forming/dimension issue at 21:57 forced a 1-hour fix and tunnel scrap — cleared by 23:12. Sollich 1 commissioning continued with 2 hours down for depositor repairs in the morning, depositing by 13:31. A drain overflow at 16:20 was traced to volume, not a clog. Sollich 3 staged materials and passed ATP for Monday's Heath trial.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 FFS had a 5-minute stop at 22:37 when the top packing belt jumped its sprocket — maintenance tightened and removed a link, back up by 22:42. ML3 had three brief pauses (fill issue, label break, sensor cleaning) totaling under 30 minutes. Hand wash sink water temperature adjusted after EE feedback.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 Truffle Line flavor pump faulted at 18:46 without triggering the alarm, forcing a hold on 1.5 pallets (26-687) — pump cleared organoleptic by 18:58 and ran monitored every 30 minutes for the rest of the window. Spring table reported issues at 02:10 but line continued. ML4 had both WDS sensors damaged during cleaning; TG3 fixed, TG4 awaiting spare. A safety-flagged blue ladder and a cable trip hazard were called out; cable was taped down by 05:11.

notes.text: Sollich 3 staged all components for Monday Heath cluster trial; z-cereal belt passed ATP at 19:36.
Cleaning rags inventory as of 06/Nov: L1 = 240, L2 = 334, L3 = 640.
Hand wash timer buttons installed and working; teams reminded to use 20-second timers.

resolved.title: Sollich 1 depositor down for repairs
resolved.summary: At 11:24, depositor down for estimated 2 hours, targeting 13:30 for test depositing.
resolved.resolution: Depositing started by 13:31 (Erandy photo). Tails/stringing significantly improved by 14:41 (Italu Martinez).

resolved.title: Sollich 4 high dimension rejections and forming issue
resolved.summary: 70% parts correct dimensions, 30% too high at 21:57; operator suspected caramel misalignment; maintenance called, pause taken.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance estimated 1 hour; tunnels 1 and 2 scrapped for level 2 clean. TG fixed by 23:12 — "TG was fixed about 15mins ago" (Caleb York).

resolved.title: Sollich 4 dry caramel texture at line start
resolved.summary: Very dry texture detected in candy from first pause; production removed pieces.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 13:33 after checking — "improved elasticity, no longer looks dry, continue to run" (Mary Montilla).

resolved.title: Sollich 1 drain overflow near marshmallow area
resolved.summary: Drain reported clogged at 16:20; water backing up in S1 marshmallow area.
resolved.resolution: Curt at 16:38 determined not a clog — volume of water from both S1 kitchen and marshmallow area exceeded drain capacity. Environmental samples collected before/after cleaning at 21:33.

resolved.title: Sollich 4 caramel too soft causing deformation
resolved.summary: Caramel too soft at 18:38, pieces deforming in cutter and overweight; operator cutting caramel, pause taken.
resolved.resolution: Operator adjusted temperatures and checked conbar tower; by 19:02 "good weight, consistency better" (Alfonsina Gil).

resolved.title: Sollich 3 z-cereal belt ready for ATP
resolved.summary: Z-cereal belt staged for ATP testing at 19:27 as part of Monday trial prep.

resolved.title: FFS top packing belt off sprocket
resolved.summary: Line down at 22:37; top packing belt off its sprocket.
resolved.resolution: Back up at 22:42 (Gustavo). Fernando at 23:10: "belt was loose, took a link off, also cleaned video jet and installed new filters."

resolved.title: ML3 fill not dispensing correctly
resolved.summary: 8-minute stop at 15:17 because fill wasn't coming out right.
resolved.resolution: Line running again at 15:46 (Molding Line 3 Filler).

resolved.title: ML3 label break during label switch
resolved.summary: Line down at 16:35 when label broke on bottom during label changeover.
resolved.resolution: Line running again at 16:39 (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: Hand wash sink water temperature too hot
resolved.summary: At 14:28, EEs reported hand wash water too hot; request to regulate to correct temperature.
resolved.resolution: William Lopez checked at 16:09 — changed schedule from auto to "Heat only" and set to Hold; roof top unit working fine, gas on.

resolved.title: ML3 CIL cleaning around chocolate sensors
resolved.summary: Line down at 19:08 for CIL cleaning around chocolate sensors.
resolved.resolution: Line running again at 19:11 (Molding Line 3 Filler).

resolved.title: Truffle Line flavor pump fault without alarm trigger
resolved.summary: Flavor pump faulted at 18:46 but did not trigger alarm on temper unit; 1 full pallet + 1 partial placed on hold (26-687).
resolved.resolution: Organoleptic passed at 18:58 (Angel Cabrera). Pump monitored every 30 minutes through end of window with no further issues — "working properly" (Itzel, 08:49).

resolved.title: Blower motor #4 shorted connection tripping breaker
resolved.summary: Shorted connection at blower motor #4 caused main breaker to trip.
resolved.resolution: Rewired connector and tested unit at 15:42 — "don't see any more problems with unit #4" (William Lopez).

resolved.title: Cable trip hazard near ML4 end packaging
resolved.summary: EE called out exposed cable as trip hazard near pallet wrapper.
resolved.resolution: Taped down at 05:11 — "problem has been resolved" (Phillip Perez).

needs_attention.title: Heavy cream tote leaking significantly
needs_attention.summary: One heavy cream tote leaking significantly at 05:35; request to transfer product to another tote to prevent further leakage.
needs_attention.status: Request posted to Jody and Brandon at 05:35; no response or action confirmed in the window.

needs_attention.title: Missing conveyor rollers from Sollich 1
needs_attention.summary: Jakob missing 4 conveyor rollers left next to inclusion depositor yesterday, plus additional rollers from elsewhere; floor asked to search.
needs_attention.status: Search request posted at 13:31 and escalated at 14:14; Jody at 22:42 reports one cart of rollers by zbelt/enrober left alone last night, but missing set not yet located.

needs_attention.title: Bolt found under Sollich 1 flow-wrap exit belt
needs_attention.summary: Operator found bolt underneath FW exit belt at 00:37; maintenance checked jaw assembly, other bolts marked same way but none missing.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance thinks bolt could be left over from 12g to 60g changeover; origin not confirmed.

needs_attention.title: FFS LPN not scanned into system before use
needs_attention.summary: At 23:07, Haydee found LPN R470971 (item 21139) not entered into system by previous shift; same issue occurred yesterday with another label.
needs_attention.status: Gustavo asked Mathew to follow up with team at 23:11; process training needed to prevent recurrence.

needs_attention.title: FFS seal jaw blade requires new cleaning procedure
needs_attention.summary: At 04:54, maintenance had rough time removing blade from seal jaw — considerable burnt-on product buildup when running snack size pouch.
needs_attention.status: Gustavo recommends cleaning blade once per shift for snack size pouch; new SOP or schedule change needed.

needs_attention.title: Blue ladder flagged as safety hazard
needs_attention.summary: William Lopez called out blue ladder near L3 breather pipe area at 15:35 in all-caps: "PLEASE DISPOSE OF THAT BLUE LADDER IT IS A SAFETY HAZARD."
needs_attention.status: Request posted at 15:35; no confirmation of removal in the window.

needs_attention.title: ML4 WDS TG4 sensor broken, awaiting spare
needs_attention.summary: Both TG3 and TG4 sensors damaged by cleaning team at 08:41; operators forced sensors instead of handling carefully. TG3 fixed by Peter, TG4 broken.
needs_attention.status: TG3 ready to go as of 08:41; TG4 broken, Nelson Cook checking for spares as of same time.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line spring table experiencing issues
needs_attention.summary: Spring table reported issues at 02:10; no detail on symptoms or cause.
needs_attention.status: Issue noted at 02:10; line continued running with no clear resolution or follow-up.
